subject: Borrowed .claude/settings.json: hooks explain a wrong CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR
body: On claude/project-thread-c4ldi5 (PR #23) each hook command now checks tools/coord.py exists under CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and otherwise prints how to fix it (SessionStart warns, others block). Behaviour is unchanged when the file exists. D-onboarding-013. Cam hit this in a desktop session that started in a scratch folder.
